description: Benchmark a machine for the Taifoon Grid in one line and see what it could earn. Returns the command to run ON the box (curl -fsSL https://www.taifoon.io/grid/bench.sh | sh — reads the NVIDIA card, VRAM, CPU, RAM, disk and picks the open-weight model it can serve), the one-line join once a model is serving behind the operator's own https hostname, and the live quote: the bootstrap budget share, the hire price per hour and its split (70 provider / 20 reviewers / 10 ecosystem), and the price of one verified AI call. Give vram_gb and gpus to get the model tier without running anything. Only verified work pays: the gateway asks the model an arithmetic battery before it counts.

owner.description: optional 0x wallet — filled into the join line

vram_gb.description: VRAM of one card in GB (0 or omitted = no GPU)

name: taifoon_grid_bench
